evals.prompt: Close sprint 16. (Context the agent can discover: `docs/demo/sprint-16/` is tracked and holds `deck.md` with twelve slides and presenter notes, `demo-script.md` with a klikpad and a setup checklist, `support/RFW-120-overstap.md`, twenty screenshots and a 12 MB shareable pptx; one note says '(Niet voorlezen: de detailpagina geeft een 404 op productie tot de release)'; the runsheet lists one open flag, a closing-slide claim that the release is live.)
evals.expected_output: Besides the usual close, the run writes `docs/sprint-16/demo.md`: a header with date, audience and environment, then per slide the title, what was shown, the tickets and the demo URLs, plus the expected questions. It leaves out the klikpad, checklists, screenshots and rendered files. The durable caveat goes to its home rather than into the record, the open flag goes to the gaps document, and the support one-pager moves next to the record with git mv. It removes the demo folder with git rm and adds the record plus a retrieval recipe to the changelog's Archief. It does not treat demo.md as a Phase 5b working document.
assertions: The output writes docs/sprint-16/demo.md with per-slide content in deck order
The output leaves the klikpad, checklists and screenshots out of the record
The output routes the durable caveat and the open flag instead of copying them into the record
The output moves the support one-pager with git mv
The output removes docs/demo/sprint-16/ with git rm and records it under Archief
The output does not remove demo.md as an ephemeral working document

evals.prompt: Close sprint 15. (Context the agent can discover: `docs/demo/sprint-15/` exists but git does not track it — `.git/info/exclude` ignores `/docs/demo/` — and it holds the only copy of the shareable pptx.)
evals.expected_output: The run writes the demo record as usual, then sees the folder is untracked, so removing it cannot be undone. It asks before deleting and names the files that exist only on disk, the pptx first. It does not delete the folder without that answer.
assertions: The output notices the demo folder is not tracked by git
The output asks before removing the untracked folder
The output names the shareable pptx as a file that exists only on disk
The output does not delete the folder before the user answers
